intro: Formative review of the B1 content; it does not replace a full assessment of the level.

frases.estudio: Selon moi, le centre sportif du quartier est très utile.
frases.alumno: In my view, the neighborhood sports center is very useful.

frases.estudio: Il propose des cours le soir et le prix est bas.
frases.alumno: It offers evening classes and the price is low.

frases.estudio: Pourtant, les habitants qui travaillent tard ne peuvent pas y aller, car le dernier bus part à vingt heures.
frases.alumno: However, residents who work late cannot go, because the last bus leaves at eight in the evening.
analisis: who work late (relative pronoun «qui» as subject)

frases.estudio: La mairie devrait prolonger les horaires le vendredi.
frases.alumno: The town hall should extend the opening hours on Fridays.
analisis: on Fridays (article with a habitual value)

texto: Formative test of grammar, vocabulary and reading comprehension for this B1 course, with one reading from each expansion chapter. The score guides review and does not certify the CEFR level.
Each question indicates the related chapter or text.

pregunta.texto: According to the reader, what is the sports center like?

opciones.texto: It is very useful and offers evening classes.
opciones.explicacion: The first and second sentences say so.

opciones.texto: It is expensive and only opens on Sundays.
opciones.explicacion: The text says the price is low.

opciones.texto: It is too small for the neighbors.
opciones.explicacion: That information does not appear.

pregunta.texto: Why can't some neighbors go?

opciones.texto: They work late and the last bus leaves at eight.
opciones.explicacion: The text gives the two related reasons.

opciones.texto: The center closes in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not say so.
The text says it is low.

pregunta.texto: What change does the reader propose?

opciones.texto: Extend the opening hours on Fridays.
opciones.explicacion: «Prolonger les horaires le vendredi».

opciones.texto: Open the center only in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: That proposal does not appear.

opciones.texto: Change the price of the courses.
opciones.explicacion: The low price is not the problem raised.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 50. How do you say «ya había comido» (had already eaten)?

opciones.explicacion: Plus-que-parfait with «avoir».
That is passé composé.
That is present.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 50. Auxiliary with «partir»

frase.texto: Quand je suis arrivé, il ___ déjà parti.

opciones.explicacion: «Partir» uses «être» in the plus-que-parfait.
«Avoir» does not go with «partir».
That is passé composé.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 51. How do you say «could come» (podría venir)?

opciones.explicacion: Conditional of «pouvoir».
That is present.
That is future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 51. What does «j'aurais dû le dire» mean?

opciones.explicacion: Criticism of something that did not happen.
That is an obligation in the present.
That is future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 51. Conditional of «aller»

frase.texto: Si j'avais le temps, je ___ au cinéma.

opciones.explicacion: Conditional of «aller»: irais.
That is present.
That is «soy» or «estoy» (I am).

pregunta.texto: Ch. 52. Subject

frase.texto: Le voisin ___ parle est gentil.

opciones.explicacion: «Qui» replaces the subject.
«Que» replaces the object.
That is an article or pronoun, not a relative.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 52. Which is correct for «the book I read»?

opciones.explicacion: «Que» replaces the direct object.
«Qui» does not go with a direct object.
That means «the book he/she reads».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 53. Subjunctive of «finir»

frase.texto: Il faut que vous ___ le travail.

opciones.explicacion: With «vous», «finir» in the subjunctive is finissiez.
That is a participle.
That is present with «tu».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 53. What is the subjunctive of «être» with «nous»?

opciones.explicacion: Irregular subjunctive of «être».
That is present.
That is future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 54. Subjunctive of «être»

frase.texto: Je doute que Léa ___ malade.

opciones.explicacion: With «il/elle», «être» in the subjunctive is soit.
That is present.
That is future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 54. What does «pour que tu sois content» express?

opciones.texto: Purpose: so that you are happy.
opciones.explicacion: «Pour que» + subjunctive.
That is «parce que».
That is «quand».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 55. Feminine singular

frase.texto: La porte est ___.

opciones.explicacion: «Porte» is feminine: fermée.
That is masculine.
That is masculine plural.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 55. How do you say «the cake is made by Léa»?

opciones.texto: Le gâteau est fait par Léa.
opciones.explicacion: «Être» + participle + «par» = passive.
That is active.
That is active in the passé composé.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 56. Gerund of «parler»

frase.texto: Elle travaille en ___ au téléphone.

opciones.explicacion: Gerund of «parler»: parlant.
That is present.
That is infinitive.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 56. What does «en arrivant» mean?

opciones.explicacion: «En» + gerund = upon arriving.
That would be «après».
That would be «avant d'arriver».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 57. Imperfect of «être»

frase.texto: Thomas a dit que Paul ___ fatigué.

opciones.explicacion: Present → imperfect with «a dit que».
That would stay the same in direct speech.
That would be future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 57. Yes-or-no question

frase.texto: Il demande ___ tu viens ce soir.

opciones.explicacion: Yes-or-no question: «si».
That does not introduce a question.
That asks when.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 57. Which is correct for «Thomas advised Paul to sleep»?

opciones.texto: Thomas a conseillé à Paul de dormir.
opciones.explicacion: «Conseiller à» + person + «de» + infinitive.

opciones.texto: Thomas a conseillé que Paul dort.
opciones.explicacion: That is not the usual construction.
«À» and «de» are missing.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 58. Masculine thing

frase.texto: Tu me donnes le livre ? Oui, je te ___ donne.

opciones.explicacion: «Livre» is masculine: «le».
That is feminine.
That is plural.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 58. Future perfect of «finir» (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)

frase.texto: Dès que tu ___ fini, je viendrai.

opciones.explicacion: Auxiliary «avoir» in the future + participle: «auras fini».
That is passé composé.
That is imperfect.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 59. Subjunctive of «être»

frase.texto: Bien que tu ___ fatigué, tu viens.

opciones.explicacion: With «tu», «être» in the subjunctive is sois.
That is present.
That is future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 59. What does «au lieu de travailler» mean?

opciones.explicacion: «Au lieu de» + infinitive.
That is «grâce à».
That is «à cause de».
